item.title: VISV-2026: DRDO Pushes Indigenous Tech and Global Defense Pacts
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
As geopolitical friction intensifies, DRDO is readying VISV-2026 in New Delhi to showcase India's cutting-edge indigenous defense tech and forge critical global partnerships. Here is what you need to know about the shift toward defense self-reliance.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Technical sessions span critical domains, including aeronautical systems, advanced missile architecture, microelectronics, and soldier modernization. [SPLIT] ⚡ The summit bridges domestic industrial ecosystems with international defense attachés and allied military delegations. item.title: DRDO’s Vikram VT-21 Clears Trials to Overhaul Army Combat Fleets
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The DRDO-TASL Vikram VT-21 Advanced Armoured Platform has cleared critical development trials, bringing India closer to replacing its aging infantry combat vehicle fleets with indigenous firepower. Dive into the tech inside the 30mm turret and amphibious platform.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The platform features an indigenously designed 30mm unmanned turret integrated with anti-tank guided missiles and a 7.62mm PKT machine gun. [SPLIT] ⚡ Industrial collaboration between DRDO lab VRDE, TASL, Bharat Forge, and MSMEs drives the development of the Indigenous Infantry Combat Vehicle. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/drdo-s-vikram-vt-21-clears-trials-to-overhaul-army-combat-fleets-357194.html
